These pedals are quite rare and was the catalog-house brand for David Wexler & Co.. This pedal is a cool sounding solid-state transistor fuzz effect pedal that sounds very good in a late 60's hard rock garage sound. The pedal also has a unique battery test system built into it. Please check out the pictures and message with questions.
